While the Perceptual Auditor sees this as minor, the Topology Auditor's mask highlights irregular edges that suggest generative instability at the subject-background interface. The sandy bottom shows repetitive noise patterns typical of AI generation. The severity is moderate (not catastrophic) because the blur is consistent with an underwater environment, but the lack of crisp edges and the slight 'mushiness' of the shark's form prevent a higher artifact score. It is better than Reference 1 (catastrophic failure) but worse than Reference 3 (clean, sharp image).
